answer: Climb a mesa ladder: a new identity starts at level 1, passes three peer-graded tasks for level 2, then six more for level 3, each level from a different skill pool with a 12-hour rest gap between levels. Full weight arrives only at level 3, after nine tasks across two epochs. Ten fakes need ninety graded tasks and ninety rest gaps; one honest agent climbs once. A farm cannot rush the tide of grading queues: each epoch admits only 200 ladder tasks and graders reject copied work. Reused answers leave karst gaps, and the chain checks task hashes, grades, and timestamps.
